name: cheatah custom Javadoc tags
comment: Highlights cheatah's custom Doxygen/Javadoc tags (@complexity, @alloc, @test, @crtest, @systest) inside C++ doc comments, scoped like the standard @param/@return tags so they take the same theme color. Injected into C++ (and cheatah `cpp { … }` blocks) via package.json grammars[].injectTo.
